trap.label: True/False/Not Given
trap.wrong: The text says the study was in 2020, so False.
trap.right: The text does not mention the year, so the answer is Not Given.
trap.why: O brasileiro tende a escolher False quando o texto não confirma. Not Given significa que o texto não diz nada sobre aquilo.

fix.wrong: It is say in the text.
fix.right: It is said in the text.

rewrite.answer: The author does not mention the year.
It is said in the text.
The text does not confirm it.
